motionClearance.title: Sampled motion clearance
motionClearance.scope: Checks exact solids at evenly spaced positions in the sweep range, including both endpoints. Positions between samples remain unchecked. This is not continuous collision detection or a physical simulation. Default gap uses the project's explicit print tolerance, or 0.2 mm. Limits: 64 samples, 8 instances for all pairs, 1,024 pair checks and 120 seconds.
motionClearance.progress: Solving and measuring exact solids: {completed} of {total} sampled positions complete…
motionClearance.coverage: {completed}/{total} sampled positions; range {start} to {end} {unit}; spacing {resolution} {unit}; required gap {minimumGap} mm.
motionClearance.complete: Requested sampled positions checked. Unsampled gaps remain unchecked; no continuous minimum or collision-free claim is made.
motionClearance.incomplete: Incomplete clearance inspection: {reason} Completed positions are partial evidence only.
motionClearance.violation: {pair}: gap {gap} mm is below the required minimum.
motionClearance.invalid-input: Choose distinct endpoints within joint limits, 2–64 samples and a nonnegative minimum gap.
motionClearance.busy: Another clearance check is still running.
motionClearance.missing-joint: The selected joint or coordinate is unavailable.
motionClearance.stale: The project, revision or frozen sources changed. Run the check again.
motionClearance.budget: The sample, pair or time budget was exceeded.
motionClearance.unsupported-mesh: Triangle meshes do not support exact clearance inspection.
motionClearance.solve-failed: A pose could not be solved or its exact sources could not be resolved.
motionClearance.missing-evidence: The exact solver did not return complete distance and material evidence.
motionClearance.poseMismatch: The solved preview differs from the sampled exact pose. No preview was displayed. Run the clearance check again.
